reading.title: After the Team Presentation
reading.text: Lina and Samir finish a team presentation. Lina feels happy and proud because the client likes their work. Samir is grateful for the help he received. Both are excited about the next project. A late change makes Lina worried, but the team stays hopeful because they have time to revise the work. She sounds joyful when she tells her colleague the good news.
reading.imageBrief: Adult colleagues after a presentation, with relaxed posture and a shared work folder. Do not use facial expression as proof of gratitude, pride or hope; these states are stated in the passage.

reading.title: A Long Day at Work
reading.text: Hala has finished a long shift. She feels tired while waiting for the bus. She is surprised when it arrives earlier than expected.
